stem:
The ordered pairs below represent the location of four people.

Paula is located at (7, 7). Based on this information, which statement is true?

options.label: A
options.text: Paula is located 1 unit south and 2 units east from Nathan.

options.label: B
options.text: Paula is located 7 units east from Wade.

options.label: C
options.text: Paula is located 3 units south and 2 units west from Denise.

options.label: D
options.text: Paula is located 6 units west from Urvasi.

visual_elements: Graph with x and y axes from 0 to 10.
Compass rose showing N, E, S, W directions.
